items.q: How much does junk removal cost?
items.a: The price depends on how much space your items take in the truck and how hard they are to reach. Send a few photos for a free estimate, or we'll quote on site before any work starts. The price we quote is the price you pay.
Furniture, mattresses, appliances, electronics, boxes, yard waste, construction debris, exercise equipment and most household or office items.
Hazardous materials: paint, solvents, chemicals, motor oil, propane tanks, asbestos and medical waste. We can point you to an LA County drop-off site for those.
Same-day pickup is often possible if you book early in the day. Next-day slots are almost always open. You choose a morning, afternoon or evening window.
Usable furniture and goods go to local donation centers. Metal, cardboard, electronics and appliances are recycled. Only what's left goes to a licensed transfer station.

items.q: Do I need to be home?
items.a: Not always. If the items are outside or in an open garage, we can do the job and send photos when it's done.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.updated: Last updated: October 2026. Draft — pending client approval.

sections.p: When you send the booking form we receive your name, phone number, ZIP code, and optionally your email, preferred date, a description of the items and up to three photos.
Only to give you an estimate, schedule the pickup and contact you about it. We don't sell your data and don't use it for advertising.
Requests are kept for up to 12 months for scheduling and accounting, then deleted. Photos are deleted after the job is done.
Our team and our email provider, which delivers the request to us. Nobody else.
California residents can ask us what data we hold about them, ask for a copy, or ask us to delete it. Email or call us and we'll handle it within 30 days.
This site doesn't use tracking cookies. Your browser stores only your language and theme choice.

items.p: By using handyhab.com, requesting an estimate or booking a pickup, you agree to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, please do not use the website or our services.
The website and services are operated by HandyHab ("HandyHab", "we", "us"), Los Angeles, California.
You must be at least 18 years old and have the authority to dispose of the items you ask us to remove.

HandyHab provides junk removal, hauling and cleanout services in Los Angeles and nearby cities, including furniture and appliance removal, garage, attic, estate and storage unit cleanouts, yard waste, construction debris and commercial hauling.

We do not remove hazardous materials, including paint, solvents, chemicals, motor oil, fuel, propane or other gas tanks, asbestos, biohazards, medical waste, firearms or ammunition. We may refuse any item we reasonably believe is unsafe, illegal or not permitted at our disposal facilities.

Usable items may be donated, and recyclable materials recycled. The rest goes to authorized disposal or transfer facilities. Once loaded on our truck, items become our responsibility to dispose of, and we may handle them at our discretion. We cannot return items after they are removed.

Estimates are free. An estimate based on photos or a description is an approximate price. Our crew confirms the final price on site before any work starts. You may decline the on-site price without charge.

The confirmed price covers the items shown to the crew. Extra items, heavier loads than described, or difficult access (for example, extra flights of stairs or long carries) may change the price. We will always tell you and get your approval first.

You choose a morning, afternoon or evening arrival window. Times are estimates; traffic or earlier jobs may cause delays, and we will contact you if we run late. Same-day service depends on availability.
Payment is due when the job is complete. We accept Zelle, Cash, Venmo, Cash App, PayPal, and Apple Pay. Prices include labor, loading, transport and disposal fees unless stated otherwise.

You can cancel or reschedule free of charge up to 24 hours before your arrival window. If you cancel less than 2 hours before your window, or if our crew arrives and cannot perform the service due to circumstances within your control (e.g., no access, nobody present, or inaccurate description of items), a trip fee of $75 will apply to cover travel and dispatch costs.
By booking a job, you confirm that:
list: you own the items or have the right to have them removed;
the items contain no hazardous materials, and you have told us about anything unusually heavy, fragile or hard to reach;
you have removed personal items, valuables, documents and data you want to keep (including from drawers, boxes and electronics);
our crew has safe, legal access to the property and the items, including any building, HOA or gate permission and parking needed.

items.p: If you are not present, items left outside or in an open area are treated as approved for removal. Please mark clearly anything that must stay.

HandyHab is insured. Our crew works with care. If we damage your property, report it within 48 hours, with photos if possible, and we will work with you to repair it or pay reasonable costs, up to the limits of our insurance.

items.b: What we are not liable for:
items.p: normal wear from moving items (for example, minor scuffs on floors or walls along the removal path when the item could not be moved otherwise); damage caused by pre-existing defects or unsafe conditions you did not tell us about; items removed at your direction or under Section 4; and indirect or consequential losses.

To the extent the law allows, our total liability for any claim related to a job is limited to the amount you paid for that job, except for damage covered by our insurance or caused by our gross negligence or willful misconduct.
You agree to cover our reasonable costs from claims caused by your false statements about item ownership, hazardous materials or property access.
Nothing in these Terms limits rights you have under California consumer protection law that cannot be waived.
You may use the website to learn about our services and request estimates. You agree not to send false requests, upload unlawful content, or interfere with the site.
By uploading photos of your items, you let us use them to prepare your estimate. We will not publish photos of your property without your permission.
Text, images, logos and design on handyhab.com belong to HandyHab and may not be copied without permission. Before-and-after photos on the site show past jobs; results vary.
How we handle your name, phone, email, ZIP code and photos is described in our Privacy Policy.
By giving us your phone number, you agree we may contact you by call, text or WhatsApp about your request. We do not send marketing messages without your consent.

If you have a problem, contact us first and we will try to resolve it within 30 days. These Terms are governed by the laws of the State of California. Any dispute not resolved informally will be handled in the state courts of Los Angeles County, California, or in small claims court where eligible.
We may update these Terms from time to time. The date at the top shows the latest version. The Terms in effect when you book apply to that job.
